cs.t: My Altec Lansing ACS48 computer speakers. I paid $299 for them in 1999 and to this day they still work flawlessly and beat most every other computer speaker. Audiophiles swear by them, and still buy them in bulk when they can find them. Here's the Amazon reviews:  https://www.amazon.com/Altec-Lansing-ACS48-Computer-Speakers...
